fusions.name: Stamp and Plant
fusions.desc: You stamp down and drive the butt of the staff into the ground, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Every Mile in It
fusions.desc: A long overhand swing at an enemy within 3 tiles that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, up to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have covered since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Leaning Rest
fusions.desc: You lean your weight on the staff and restore 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Road Legs

riders.text: the walking rhythm carries into the swing

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1 and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze you move 5% faster, from silver the staff gives you 4% dodge chance, and from gold you attack 6% faster.
